name: android_click_element
description: Taps an element: by id, the [#ID] from the latest android_get_ui_tree (most reliable), or by text (case-insensitive substring), resourceId, or contentDesc. Give id or at least one of the other three.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

text.description: Visible text of the element to click.

resourceId.description: Resource ID of the element to click.

contentDesc.description: Accessibility description of the element to click.
